designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

The design system embodies the pinnacle of Italian automotive luxury, extreme performance, and timeless craftsmanship tailored for high-end mobile experiences. Designed for collectors, racing enthusiasts, and discerning clients, the interface commands absolute focus through stark contrast, cinematic presentation, and architectural discipline.

The visual style blends **High-Contrast Minimalism** with **Tactile Luxury Engineering**:
- **Pure Black Canvas**: True pitch black serves as the foundation, evoking aerodynamic carbon fiber, track tarmac, and ultra-premium showroom curation while optimizing OLED efficiency.
- **Precision Engineering**: Razor-sharp hairline boundaries, geometric metrics, and disciplined grid alignments mirror high-performance telemetry and automotive chassis design.
- **Cinematic Drama**: Edge-to-edge photography, deep vignettes, and calculated focal strikes in iconic Corsa Red channel visceral speed without cluttering the interface with frivolous decorative noise.
- **Restraint and Presence**: Luxury is communicated through generous negative vertical rhythm, unyielding typographic structure, and frictionless mechanical feedback.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is architected around a default mobile viewport width of 390px, structured with strict mathematical discipline and cinematic flexibility:

- **Grid Model**: A standard 4-column fluid mobile grid with `1.25rem` (20px) outer canvas margins and `1rem` (16px) gutters. Elements snap precisely to this framework.
- **Edge-to-Edge Media Breaks**: Hero photography, 360-degree vehicle configurators, and video banners must escape standard canvas margins, stretching to the full 100vw edge to maximize impact.
- **Vertical Hierarchy**:
  - `space-xs` (4px) & `space-sm` (8px): Fine spacing within component clusters (metric value to unit label, icon to text).
  - `space-md` (16px): Standard gap between form fields, list items, and compact cards.
  - `space-lg` (24px): Padding inside luxury cards, accordions, and grouped container blocks.
  - `space-xl` (40px): Section breaks between narrative vehicle chapters, telemetry modules, and imagery blocks.
- **Safe Area Anchors**: Sticky bottom controls (e.g., "CONFIGURE", "INQUIRE") account for device home indicators with safe area padding, flanked by backdrop blur gradients.

## Elevation & Depth

In alignment with automotive minimalism, depth is achieved without heavy drop shadows. The design system uses **Tonal Layers**, **Vignettes**, and **Hairline Outlines**:

- **Layer 0 (Canvas Base)**: Pitch black (`#000000`).
- **Layer 1 (Card & Module Surfaces)**: Solid charcoal surfaces (`#080808` to `#111111`) set directly on Layer 0, delineated by a single 1px hairline border of `#222222`.
- **Layer 2 (Floating & Fixed Navigational Bars)**: Semi-translucent obsidian (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)`) coupled with a heavy backdrop filter (`blur(20px)`), bordered by a bottom hairline of `#222222`.
- **Cinematic Vignettes**: Image containers utilize subtle linear edge vignettes (`linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%, #000000 100%)`) to gracefully dissolve full-bleed photography into text sections below.
- **Focused Elevation**: Interacted items (e.g., active accordion or selected specification pill) glow subtly with a focused red boundary transition rather than an elevation cast shadow.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Button (Rosso Action)**: Full-width or inline block, 0px border-radius, solid `#E8000D` background, pure white `#FFFFFF` uppercase typography (`label-strong`), 48px height. Active press triggers an instant drop to `#B3000A`.
- **Secondary Button (Outline)**: 0px border-radius, transparent background, 1px `#FFFFFF` or `#CCCCCC` border, white uppercase text.
- **Circular Icon Button**: Perfect 44px circle, `#111111` fill with a 1px `#222222` hairline border. Icons rendered in crisp white `#FFFFFF` at 18px. Active state shifts border to `#E8000D`.

### Accordions
- Monolithic styling framed by top and bottom 1px `#222222` borders.
- Header showcases uppercase category titles (`headline-sm`) in `#FFFFFF` with minimal plus/minus (`+`/`−`) or precision chevron indicators.
- Expanded content sits against `#080808` with smooth height easing and zero shadow bleed.

### Pagination & Indicators
- **Sleek Pagination Dots**: Active step rendered as an elongated horizontal pill (16px × 2px) in `#E8000D` or pure `#FFFFFF`. Inactive dots rendered as miniature circular dots (4px × 4px) in `#444444`.
- **Progress Trackers**: 1px high continuous hairline bar traversing the top or bottom of multi-step configurator screens.

### Cards & Telemetry Displays
- **Vehicle Showcase Card**: Edge-to-edge media block with bottom metadata overlay. Dark charcoal background (`#0A0A0A`), delimited by 1px `#222222` border.
- **Spec Grid**: Dual-column telemetry modules presenting numeric values (`metric-val`) in `#FFFFFF` stacked above uppercase tracked descriptors (`category-eyebrow`) in `#999999`.

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Input Fields**: Rectangular flat box, 48px height, `#0A0A0A` surface with 1px `#222222` border. Floating placeholder text transitions to `#999999`. Focus state transitions border strictly to `#E8000D`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**:
  - Checkbox: Sharp 18px square, `#111111` fill, 1px `#333333` border. Checked state displays `#E8000D` fill with a sharp white checkmark.
  - Radio: Concentric circle design. Outer 18px circle, `#222222` border; checked state features an inner `#E8000D` dot.

### Chips & Filters
- Compact horizontal-scrolling badges. Sharp 0px borders. Inactive chips use `#111111` background, 1px `#222222` border, and `#999999` text. Active chips invert to solid `#FFFFFF` background with `#000000` text or solid `#E8000D` with `#FFFFFF` text.

   - Fullscreen 390×844 charcoal gradient navigation menu with close button and Escape key support.
   - Accessible client-side search modal.
   - Fully keyboard- and touch-enabled hero and news carousels with authentic official destination links.

## Brand & Style

The design system embodies the pinnacle of Italian automotive luxury, extreme performance, and timeless craftsmanship tailored for high-end mobile experiences. Designed for collectors, racing enthusiasts, and discerning clients, the interface commands absolute focus through stark contrast, cinematic presentation, and architectural discipline.

The visual style blends **High-Contrast Minimalism** with **Tactile Luxury Engineering**:
- **Pure Black Canvas**: True pitch black serves as the foundation, evoking aerodynamic carbon fiber, track tarmac, and ultra-premium showroom curation while optimizing OLED efficiency.
- **Precision Engineering**: Razor-sharp hairline boundaries, geometric metrics, and disciplined grid alignments mirror high-performance telemetry and automotive chassis design.
- **Cinematic Drama**: Edge-to-edge photography, deep vignettes, and calculated focal strikes in iconic Corsa Red channel visceral speed without cluttering the interface with frivolous decorative noise.
- **Restraint and Presence**: Luxury is communicated through generous negative vertical rhythm, unyielding typographic structure, and frictionless mechanical feedback.

## Colors

The palette is rooted in pure chiaroscuro contrast punctuated by Ferrari Corsa Red. Surfaces, typography, and borders follow a strict luminous hierarchy:

- **Primary Accent (`#E8000D` / `#E00613`)**: Rosso Corsa. Reserved strictly for primary call-to-actions, active telemetry highlights, ignition states, and crucial status signifiers. It must never be diluted or overused as generic background wash.
- **Base Canvas & Surfaces**:
  - `Surface Canvas`: `#000000` (Pure pitch black for total immersion and depth).
  - `Surface Elevated / Card`: `#080808` to `#111111` (Deep charcoal monoliths for structural grouping).
  - `Surface Overlay`: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)` with backdrop filters for floating navigational layers.
- **Borders & Dividers**:
  - `Border Hairline`: `#222222` (Ultra-subtle, razor-thin structural dividers).
  - `Border Active`: `#E8000D` (Tactile focus states).
- **Text & Luminous Hierarchy**:
  - `Primary White`: `#FFFFFF` (Headlines, prominent metrics, vehicle nomenclatures).
  - `Secondary Silver`: `#CCCCCC` (Supporting specifications, body descriptions).
  - `Muted Platinum`: `#999999` (Labels, category tracking headers, metadata, and inactive icons).
  - `Disabled / Ghost`: `#444444`.

## Typography

The typographic system utilizes **Space Grotesk** for headlines, metrics, and high-impact navigational elements to project modern automotive engineering precision, paired with **Hanken Grotesk** for body copy to provide Swiss-inspired, uncompromised legibility.

- **Uppercase Tracking Rules**: Category eyebrows, vehicle classifications, and primary action labels must always be capitalized with expanded letter-spacing (`0.12em` to `0.22em`).
- **Telemetry Readouts**: Acceleration figures, engine outputs, and vehicle specs (e.g., `0-100 KM/H`, `830 CV`) must render in `metric-val` using tabular numeral behavior for clean vertical balance.
- **Editorial Contrast**: Hero headlines juxtapose razor-thin labels with dense, weighty model names (e.g., `296 GTB`, `SF90 STRADALE`).

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is architected around a default mobile viewport width of 390px, structured with strict mathematical discipline and cinematic flexibility:

- **Grid Model**: A standard 4-column fluid mobile grid with `1.25rem` (20px) outer canvas margins and `1rem` (16px) gutters. Elements snap precisely to this framework.
- **Edge-to-Edge Media Breaks**: Hero photography, 360-degree vehicle configurators, and video banners must escape standard canvas margins, stretching to the full 100vw edge to maximize impact.
- **Vertical Hierarchy**:
  - `space-xs` (4px) & `space-sm` (8px): Fine spacing within component clusters (metric value to unit label, icon to text).
  - `space-md` (16px): Standard gap between form fields, list items, and compact cards.
  - `space-lg` (24px): Padding inside luxury cards, accordions, and grouped container blocks.
  - `space-xl` (40px): Section breaks between narrative vehicle chapters, telemetry modules, and imagery blocks.
- **Safe Area Anchors**: Sticky bottom controls (e.g., "CONFIGURE", "INQUIRE") account for device home indicators with safe area padding, flanked by backdrop blur gradients.

## Elevation & Depth

In alignment with automotive minimalism, depth is achieved without heavy drop shadows. The design system uses **Tonal Layers**, **Vignettes**, and **Hairline Outlines**:

- **Layer 0 (Canvas Base)**: Pitch black (`#000000`).
- **Layer 1 (Card & Module Surfaces)**: Solid charcoal surfaces (`#080808` to `#111111`) set directly on Layer 0, delineated by a single 1px hairline border of `#222222`.
- **Layer 2 (Floating & Fixed Navigational Bars)**: Semi-translucent obsidian (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)`) coupled with a heavy backdrop filter (`blur(20px)`), bordered by a bottom hairline of `#222222`.
- **Cinematic Vignettes**: Image containers utilize subtle linear edge vignettes (`linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%, #000000 100%)`) to gracefully dissolve full-bleed photography into text sections below.
- **Focused Elevation**: Interacted items (e.g., active accordion or selected specification pill) glow subtly with a focused red boundary transition rather than an elevation cast shadow.

## Shapes

The design system adheres to **Sharp Geometry** (`roundedness: 0`). 

- **Architectural Edge**: All structural components, cards, input inputs, banners, and primary CTA buttons feature absolute 0px border-radii, expressing high-precision mechanical machining and the aggressive silhouette of aerodynamic bodywork.
- **The Circle Exception**: Precision controls that represent mechanical dials, vehicle rotation cues, or steering touchpoints (such as circular icon buttons, audio toggles, pagination indicator dots, and Manettino-inspired mode selectors) use pure geometric circles (`50%` radius), providing functional contrast against rectilinear blocks.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Button (Rosso Action)**: Full-width or inline block, 0px border-radius, solid `#E8000D` background, pure white `#FFFFFF` uppercase typography (`label-strong`), 48px height. Active press triggers an instant drop to `#B3000A`.
- **Secondary Button (Outline)**: 0px border-radius, transparent background, 1px `#FFFFFF` or `#CCCCCC` border, white uppercase text.
- **Circular Icon Button**: Perfect 44px circle, `#111111` fill with a 1px `#222222` hairline border. Icons rendered in crisp white `#FFFFFF` at 18px. Active state shifts border to `#E8000D`.

### Accordions
- Monolithic styling framed by top and bottom 1px `#222222` borders.
- Header showcases uppercase category titles (`headline-sm`) in `#FFFFFF` with minimal plus/minus (`+`/`−`) or precision chevron indicators.
- Expanded content sits against `#080808` with smooth height easing and zero shadow bleed.

### Pagination & Indicators
- **Sleek Pagination Dots**: Active step rendered as an elongated horizontal pill (16px × 2px) in `#E8000D` or pure `#FFFFFF`. Inactive dots rendered as miniature circular dots (4px × 4px) in `#444444`.
- **Progress Trackers**: 1px high continuous hairline bar traversing the top or bottom of multi-step configurator screens.

### Cards & Telemetry Displays
- **Vehicle Showcase Card**: Edge-to-edge media block with bottom metadata overlay. Dark charcoal background (`#0A0A0A`), delimited by 1px `#222222` border.
- **Spec Grid**: Dual-column telemetry modules presenting numeric values (`metric-val`) in `#FFFFFF` stacked above uppercase tracked descriptors (`category-eyebrow`) in `#999999`.

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Input Fields**: Rectangular flat box, 48px height, `#0A0A0A` surface with 1px `#222222` border. Floating placeholder text transitions to `#999999`. Focus state transitions border strictly to `#E8000D`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**:
  - Checkbox: Sharp 18px square, `#111111` fill, 1px `#333333` border. Checked state displays `#E8000D` fill with a sharp white checkmark.
  - Radio: Concentric circle design. Outer 18px circle, `#222222` border; checked state features an inner `#E8000D` dot.

### Chips & Filters
- Compact horizontal-scrolling badges. Sharp 0px borders. Inactive chips use `#111111` background, 1px `#222222` border, and `#999999` text. Active chips invert to solid `#FFFFFF` background with `#000000` text or solid `#E8000D` with `#FFFFFF` text.
